structured_output.what_is_happening: A "TOE ROGAN" clone war is underway. At least 8 same-name TOE tokens were launched between about 11:41 and 12:00 UTC, all apparently reacting to a @joeroganhq X post (status 2103809558397526244, which I could not read: HTTP 402). This coin (97brr…) is a late clone launched through a Meteora virtual curve and moved to PumpSwap. It pumped about 120% to roughly $108k but was already falling at T2 (DexScreener m5 -16%, mcap about $89k). The two earlier clones, F3C2 and 6ZHF, are also dumping (-26% and -39% over m5). Its project "website" field points to usepaid.app for a different token (F3C2), which suggests the metadata was copied.

narrative.description: A pun on a Joe Rogan toe ("Toe Rogan"), apparently set off by a post from the joeroganhq account. An older 'Toe Rogan' meme community already exists (the parody X account @JoeTheToeRogan, toerogan.xyz for the TOEROGAN token FbYY…).
narrative.why_spreading: A celebrity-post trigger, and many deployers launched copies within minutes. The attention is split across 8+ clones, and the front-runners are already fading.

token_connection.why_this_token: None found. It is not the first clone (7Y7P, F3C2 and 6ZHF came earlier), and its website field links to F3C2's usepaid page. It has no socials, site or DexScreener profile of its own.
token_connection.competing_tokens: F3C2t4hX… (earliest big one, $124k), 6ZHF4kuz… ($122k, $834k h1 volume), 9ZDZ, 7ExR, the older TOEROGAN FbYY… with its own site toerogan.xyz, plus several pump.fun copies.

authenticity.evidence: There are 1,287 unique buyers against 121 sellers, and GMGN shows a low bot/degen rate. But GMGN tags 75 bundler wallets, and the clone-farming pattern (8+ copies inside 20 minutes) is typical of deployer farms rotating liquidity.
authenticity.uncertainty: I could not read the source X post, and no discussion specific to this contract was found.

structural_risks: RugCheck flags 99.99% of LP as unlocked (danger), though GMGN reports an LP burn ratio of 1.0. The two sources conflict.
The creator status is creator_close. The dev has launched 2 tokens, with a best ATH of about $121k.
The top holder has 80% of supply (possibly a curve or vault account; unclear).
Buyers are split across many clones, and the price was already falling at T2.

structured_output.counterargument: Joe Rogan is a huge name. If his real account posted something toe-related, the story could grow, and the unique-buyer count (1,287 in about 15 minutes) is strong. Clone wars sometimes resolve by picking a random winner, and this one has comparable liquidity and a non-trivial buyer base.
